components.name: Retro primary button
components.description: Retro-only specimen of the existing shared button variant. Live-bound to root retro tokens; light fallbacks make the isolated preview readable. No application action is wired.
components.css: .ds-retro-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;height:2.25rem;padding:0 .75rem;border:2px solid var(--retro-line, #24212c);border-radius:var(--retro-radius, 3px);background:var(--retro-action, #6d28d9);color:var(--retro-action-text, #ffffff);font-family:inherit;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.25rem;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;transform:none;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,box-shadow 120ms ease-out,translate 120ms ease-out;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--retro-shadow, #24212c);}.ds-retro-button-primary:not(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]):hover{background:var(--retro-action-hover, #5b21b6)}.ds-retro-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--retro-focus, #6d28d9);outline-offset:3px}.ds-retro-button-primary:not(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]):active{translate:2px 2px;box-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--retro-shadow, #24212c)}.ds-retro-button-primary:is(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]){opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:none;translate:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-retro-button-primary{transition-duration:.01ms}.ds-retro-button-primary:not(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]):active{translate:none}}

narrative.overview:
Matterhorn is a focused, desk-first workspace for doing useful work through chat. Preserve the real logo, protocol marks, readable incumbent type, theme preferences and explicit review boundaries. The opt-in retro workbench uses flat paper/charcoal planes, ink outlines, violet actions, ice selection and hard offset depth; it is a visual alternative, not a rebrand or a simulated trading game.

The incumbent interface remains the default. Retro styling is scoped to the root marker set by the default-off build flag, and both interfaces use the same routes, persisted chats, model selections and draft stores. This source-backed contract documents implementation, not hosted deployment, installed-app typography acceptance or real agent/chain execution.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar Matterhorn identity and compact operational typography.
Default-off retro geometry with separately preserved incumbent styling.
One focused conversation and contextual tools on demand.
Explicit focus, selection, unavailable states and reviewed-action boundaries.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply retro values only under the opt-in root marker; flag-off surfaces keep the incumbent semantic system.

rules.name: The Inherited Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve existing font assets, family preferences and readable text hierarchy; the retro flag changes geometry and emphasis, not font identity.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use hard offsets to identify actions and raised work surfaces; keep reading and conversation planes quiet.

dos: Do preserve the Matterhorn logo, protocol marks, existing type, user font preferences and both themes.
Do keep retro scoped to its default-off flag and distinguish minimal-only, retro and incumbent layouts.
Do keep required consent, source/freshness, transaction terms, signer boundaries and unavailable states explicit.
Do use server capability data rather than visual readiness assumptions.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, editable drafts and contextual tool navigation.
donts: Don't treat a local opt-in, a synthetic screenshot or this document as deployed rollout, installed-app typography acceptance or real execution proof.
Don't enable the minimal or retro layout for production before live runtime acceptance.
Don't introduce new fonts, pixel body text, decorative dashboards, gradients, duplicate navigation rails or fabricated statistics.
Don't use customer-facing Crypto workspace, Services, Computer Use, OpenWork or unexplained OpenCode copy.
Don't collect seed phrases, private keys, mnemonics, raw signatures, signed payloads, wallet exports, API secrets or exchange secrets in UI fields.

Don't allow agent-initiated, watch-triggered, unattended or unreviewed submission; Polymarket submission without explicit allowed compliance; unsupported Bittensor write submission; or hidden signing claims.
Don't ship trapped rails, horizontal overflow, nested scrolling inside cards, composer overlap, clipped button text or cards inside cards.
